items.headline: Council agenda: LinkedIn development agreement amendment on second reading
items.summary: The October 27 City Council agenda listed a second reading of an amendment to LinkedIn's development agreement covering 700-810 East Middlefield Road and 1100-1200 Maude Avenue. A second reading is the final step before an ordinance takes effect.

items.headline: Council agenda: tax-exempt bond financing for apartments at 334 San Antonio Road
items.summary: The October 27 City Council agenda listed multi-family housing tax-exempt bond financing for 334 San Antonio Road. Bonds like these are a tool for financing apartment construction.

items.headline: Council agenda: design concept for Highway 237 and Middlefield Road interchange
items.summary: The October 27 City Council agenda listed the design concept for State Route 237 and Middlefield Road Interchange Improvements (Project 19-65). It also listed pre-qualification of bidders and subcontractors for the Public Safety Building (Project 20-49).

items.headline: Council closed session listed City Attorney pay talks and appointment
items.summary: The October 27 closed session agenda listed a labor negotiation conference for the unrepresented City Attorney position. It also listed a public employee appointment for the title of City Attorney.

items.headline: Altera office tenant improvement permitted at 141 Innovation Drive
items.summary: A permit was issued for an interior tenant improvement for Altera at 141 Innovation Drive, an office building, with a permit valuation of $3,400,000. A separate R&D lab tenant improvement for Teradyne at 90 Headquarters Drive (permit valuation $3,150,000) was issued the day before.

items.headline: Sunnyvale duplex at 536 Hawthorn Avenue could become three townhomes
items.summary: The Planning Commission's October 26 study session agenda listed a proposal to demolish a 1,360-square-foot duplex on a 0.29-acre R-3 lot and build three townhome-style condominiums in one two-story building. The application also includes a tentative parcel map to split the parcel into three lots.

items.headline: Citywide residential parking rules rewrite: continuance to November 9 requested
items.summary: The October 26 Planning Commission agenda carried a request to continue to November 9 a recommendation to the City Council on a proposed ordinance to repeal and replace Sunnyvale's parking chapter (19.46). The ordinance would also amend the Downtown, Lawrence Station, and El Camino Real specific plan districts, the definitions chapter, and the Dual Urban Opportunity Housing chapter.

items.headline: Seven-unit condo building permitted at 1141 W San Carlos Street
items.summary: A building permit was issued for Bldg 3 of the Condo Foundry project at 1141 W San Carlos Street, a new condo building with a permit valuation of $2,116,142. The source reports 7 dwelling units, though that field may not match the building description.
